05 / ABOUT ME

Creative by experience.
Driven by technology.

I’m Mohamed Mohamed Hussein, a Computer Science student at Kuala Lumpur University of Science and Technology, focusing on data science. My interests cover data analytics, programming, graphic design, multimedia and digital communication.

I have more than three years of graphic design experience and have worked as a graphic design lecturer, social media manager and cameraman. I currently support digital communication and creative work at Tech Grow Training and Innovation Center and Sahal Institute of Computer and Information Technology. At university, I serve as Social Media Officer for SSA-KLUST and contribute to multimedia and social media management for KLUST Cyber Alliance.

My technical skills include Python, Java, SQL, Power BI, Excel, HTML and CSS. I also use Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Canva, Figma and CapCut to create visual and multimedia content.

Through my academic projects and professional experience, I have developed strong communication, teamwork, leadership, critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. I enjoy learning, taking responsibility and using both creativity and technology to produce meaningful work.
